show.description: Kabir, once dismissed as weak, is secretly a powerful CEO betrayed by his ambitious wife Sonia, who falls for a conman, Sunny. As deception unravels, Kabir rises from humiliation to reclaim his identity, exposing lies and seeking justice with the help of Meghna, ultimately turning betrayal into a path of strength and redemption. Watch now.
